label: D1 of the last five trials after an unrewarded common a2->S2, strongest when belief still favors S2
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) ;; last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) * (belief_lo < 0) ;; (phase != D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95)
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 90) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 85) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") * (ep_trial >= 95) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == -1) * (ep_trial >= 95)
explanation: Very sparse feature (nonzero on 0.1% of steps), active only at D1 in roughly the last 5-10 trials of the episode, almost exclusively after an unrewarded common a2->S2 trial (or an unrewarded trial with unknown history at the window start). Within that, magnitude is larger when the ideal observer still believes S2 is good (belief_lo < 0, graded) and when the trial before was rewarded (first miss after a reward); it is suppressed after two misses in a row. Other previous-trial patterns, GO and D2 are silent. The crux is a 4-way conjunction (D1 x a2 S2 u x late episode x S2 belief) that the 3-factor short form cannot express directly; the short form approximates it with an all-phase belief interaction plus a non-D1 correction term. Free fit (dev 0.57) adds graded lateness (from trial ~85), graded belief_lo and the trial-before reward/choice; short form dev 0.34. No future variables used.
